title: Bigger checkboxes and a Permissions sheet
summary: Checkboxes are easier to tap, and each character's field permissions open in their own sheet.
items: Checkboxes are 24 px with a full-width 44 px row to tap, on Party, shop editing and elsewhere.
Each Party character card has a Permissions… button that opens that character's individual field permissions in a sheet, instead of a long list on the card.
The toast close button is larger, and small links such as ← Market, Open inventory & ledger and Remove account have a 24 px tap target.
